issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a pinned MSRV lane (`cargo +1.85 check --all-targets`) in `bead-rs-ci` so the declared 1.85 floor is tested on every run instead of asserted, with the lane's toolchain pinned to the exact `rust-version` in Cargo.toml and any drift between them failing CI. No bead tracks this lane. Add the lane step to the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate, a drift check against the manifest, and record one green run as verification evidence.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Stand up the pinned MSRV verification lane in bead-rs-ci with manifest-drift failure (ADR-004)

issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) commits bead-rs to a third dependency kind, `verifies`, that lets an author declare a check relationship, plus a structural advisory diagnosis of inverted verification gates (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead). The ADR explicitly scopes this as post-0.1 item R025 and the codebase is now past 0.2, yet no open bead tracks it. Work: extend the dependency model and `bead dep` CLI with the `verifies` kind (never rejecting at insert time — diagnosis is report-only), surface inversion findings through existing diagnostic output, never infer the relationship from issue titles, update `bead schema explain`/the field guide and the plan's two-kind §3.4 set, and add conformance tests covering both the inverted case and the legitimate 'prove the baseline is green before anyone touches this' ordering that is structurally identical.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the `verifies` dependency kind and advisory inversion diagnosis (R025, ADR-001)
